name: rotations-panel
description: Rotations panel for Chronicle EventsPanels. Displays spell cast timelines as icons on a horizontal time axis. Default view shows one row per player; focus view (single entity selected) shows one row per spell ability. Uses spell_go/spell_start/spell_fail streams. Supports zoom, shift+scroll panning, and panel filters. Use when: modifying rotations panel UX, adding features to the cast timeline, changing how spell casts are visualized, or debugging rotation display issues.
